title: Logistics: Integrations
summary: Tie item movement to power budgets, machines, maps, storage, and terminal work orders.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: PowerGrid keeps request blocks alive, Index and Wiki document items, Convoy benefits from staged cargo, and TutorialCore can explain missing network pieces.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Feed Convoy staging, Reclamation food loops, PowerGrid maintenance kits, and Terminal operations with the same readable supply language.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: Without linked machines or terminal views, keep routes simple: one source, one destination, one filter goal, and a visible overflow chest.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
